programmeBoundary.text: Wordfence Bug Bounty Program, campaign boundary revised 2026-10-17. In scope for this campaign: impact reachable by an unauthenticated visitor, a Subscriber or a Customer. Highest value: arbitrary PHP file upload or read, arbitrary PHP file deletion, remote code execution, authentication bypass to admin, privilege escalation to admin. Also in scope: account takeover, stored XSS, SQL injection, arbitrary file read, download or delete, local or remote file inclusion, and directory traversal. Out of scope for this campaign: sensitive information disclosure; access to private, draft or password-protected content; basic information disclosure; arbitrary content deletion; arbitrary options update; privilege escalation or authentication bypass that stops below admin; reflected XSS; CSRF; missing authorization; IDOR; denial of service; business-logic-only impact; and routes requiring Contributor, Author, Editor, Shop Manager or Administrator, or an administrator's explicit configuration or grant of permissions.
